flatten_object_to_dict: flatten a Python object into a JSON-serializable dictionary using jsonpickle with keys enabled
restore_object_from_dict: restore a Python object from a JSON-serializable dictionary using jsonpickle with keys enabled
flatten_numpy_array: flatten a numpy array into a JSON-serializable dictionary using jsonpickle with registered numpy handlers
restore_pandas_dataframe: restore a pandas DataFrame from a JSON-serializable dictionary using jsonpickle with registered pandas handlers
